questions.question: Match List-I with List-II

questions.q:
Match the following Lists.(a → edge length, $\mathrm{r}+\rightarrow$ radius of cation, $\mathrm{r} \rightarrow \rightarrow$ radius of anion) \(
List-IList-II
(P) NaCl type crystal(1) $\sqrt{3}$a=4\left($r_{+}+r_{-}\right)
(Q) ZnS type crystal(2) $\sqrt{3}$a=2\left($r_{+}+r_{-}\right)
(R) CsCl type crystal(3) $\sqrt{2}$a=2\left($r_{+}+r_{-}\right)
(S) A_3 B type crystal in which anion B
forms simple cubic unit cell and cation A
occupies all the square planar voids		(4) a=2\left($r_{+}+r_{-}\right)
\)
questions.solution:
In NaCl crystal Cl ions form fcc unit cell and $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ ions occupy all theoctahedral voids.
$\therefore \quad a=2  \left(r_{+}+r_{-}\right)$
In ZnS crystal $\mathrmS^{2-}$ ions form fcc unit cell and $\mathrm{Zn}^{2+}$ions occupy alternate tetrahedral voids
$\therefore \quad $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}$a=  \left(r_{+}+r_{-}\right)$
In CsCl crystal, $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ions form simple cubic unit cell and $\mathrm{Cs}^{+}$ions occupy the centre of each cube
$\therefore \quad \sqrt{3}a=2  \left(r_{+}+r_{-}\right)$
In $\mathrm{A}}_{3} $\mathrm{~B}crystal, anions $\mathrmB^{-3}$ ions form simple cubic unit cell and cations $\mathrmA^{+}$occupy square planar voids.
$\therefore \quad \sqrt{2}a=2  \left($r_{+}+r_{-}\right)
